title: Video Edit Flow on MiniMax H3 Reference - swap a person, head or outfit, or any edit, with an optional mask step
description: ONE Flow, decided with Fabio 2026-10-06 (replaces MPI-711's Bernini route). Input: a clip + an optional photo. A 'What to change' picker (Swap the person / Swap the head / Change the outfit / Anything else) selects a hidden instruction that the user's own words are appended to, and whether the photo is required. Optional mask step, as Detail/Inpaint/Edit already do on images: crop-and-stitch round the masked region keeps the rest of the frame and its resolution untouched, and a small region renders ten times faster or more (Fabio). The mask step is MPI-715 (mask clip transport + adjust gizmo), which the video detailer MPI-557 also needs. Member of umbrella MPI-897. Brief + plan: brief.md, plan.md.
